a:

here is my translation from: https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/XXXXX#english

XXXXX is a hybridized cultivar of b. disticha, b. bicolor, b. juncea, b. rapa and a. anserina with the following characteristics, namely, a dark-green, erect branching culm. the flowers are fragrant red. the leaves are alternate, pointed and green. the roots are red and smooth. it flowers, fruits and seeds attractively. the plant has been widely grown in central europe.

a:

so it's just two terms, one word that is used to describe the plants in english and another one that is used for all plants that native to english.  so this is the only place that i am aware of which has a precise, formal definition.  i would use "pink blossom" and "XXXXX" interchangeably, but it is a bit awkward because the two terms are so different.
